# bash completion for homepodctl
# Shared Bash/Zsh argument walk. Metadata and candidate arrays are generated.
_homepodctl_contains() {
  local wanted="$1" item
  shift
  for item in "$@"; do
    [[ "$item" == "$wanted" ]] && return 0
  done
  return 1
}

_homepodctl_context() {

      terminal=('--help' '-h')

      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=1 literal=0 ;;
    'automation')
      options=()
      value_flags=()

      boolean_flags=()

      terminal=('--help' '-h')
      children=()
      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;
    'setup')
      options=('--backend' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '--room' '-h')
      value_flags=('--backend' '--room')
      position_flags=()
      boolean_flags=('--json' '--no-input')
      terminal=('--help' '-h')
      children=()
      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;
    'status')
      options=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '--watch' '-h')
      value_flags=('--watch')
      position_flags=()
      boolean_flags=('--json' '--plain')
      terminal=('--help' '-h')
      children=()
      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;
    'stop')
      options=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h')
      value_flags=()

      terminal=('--help' '-h')

      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;
    'version')
      options=('--help' '-h')
      value_flags=()

      boolean_flags=()
      terminal=('--help' '-h')
      children=()
      positional='' start=0 repeat=0 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;
    'vol')
      options=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume' '-h')

      children=()
      positional='rooms' start=1 repeat=1 stop=0 legacy=0 literal=0 ;;

  esac
}

_homepodctl_value_group() {
  value_group='none'
  case "$1" in
    '--backend') value_group='backends' ;;
    '--playlist') value_group='playlists' ;;
    '--preset') value_group='presets' ;;
    '--room') value_group='rooms' ;;

  esac
}

_homepodctl_boolean_word() {
  local word="$1"
  word="${word#"${word%%[!$' \t\r\n']*}"}"
  word="${word%"${word##*[!$' \t\r\n']}"}"
  case "$word" in
0|1|[fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|[nN]|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]|[oO][nN]|[tT][rR][uU][eE]|[yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

_homepodctl_scan() {
  local context=root pending='' optional=0 ended=0 position=0 offset=0 word flag value attached flag_legacy
  local positional start repeat stop legacy literal value_group
  local -a options value_flags position_flags boolean_flags terminal children
  group=none
  _homepodctl_context "$context"
  while (( $# > 1 )); do
    word="$1"
    shift
    if [[ -n "$pending" ]]; then
      pending=''
      continue
    fi
    if (( optional )); then
      optional=0
      _homepodctl_boolean_word "$word" && continue
    fi
    if (( ! ended )); then
      if [[ "$word" == -- ]]; then
        [[ "$context" == root ]] && return
        # A delimiter before plan's target belongs to the wrapper only.
        [[ "$context" != plan ]] && ended=1
        continue
      fi
      if [[ "$word" == -* && "$word" != - ]]; then
        flag="${word%%=*}"
        value='' attached=0 flag_legacy=$legacy
        if [[ "$word" == *=* ]]; then value="${word#*=}"; attached=1; fi
        [[ "$context" == plan* && "$flag" == --json ]] && flag_legacy=1
        if (( legacy )) && [[ "$flag" != --* && "$flag" != -h && "$flag" != -f ]]; then flag="-$flag"; fi
        [[ "$flag" == -f && "$word" != -f ]] && return
        _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${options[@]}" || return
        if _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${terminal[@]}"; then return; fi
        if _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${value_flags[@]}"; then
          if _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${position_flags[@]}"; then offset=1; fi
          if (( ! attached )) || { [[ -z "$value" ]] && (( ! flag_legacy )); }; then pending="$flag"; fi
        elif _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${boolean_flags[@]}"; then
          if (( ! attached )) || { [[ -z "$value" ]] && (( ! flag_legacy )); }; then optional=1; fi
        elif (( attached )); then
          return
        fi
        continue
      fi
    fi
    if (( position == 0 )) && _homepodctl_contains "$word" "${children[@]}"; then
      if [[ "$context" == root ]]; then context="$word"; else context="$context $word"; fi
      _homepodctl_context "$context"
      continue
    fi
    if (( literal || stop )); then return; fi
    if (( ${#children[@]} > 0 )) && [[ -z "$positional" ]]; then return; fi
    position=$((position + 1))
  done
  current="$1"
  if [[ -n "$pending" ]]; then
    _homepodctl_value_group "$pending"
    group="$value_group"
  elif (( ! ended )) && [[ "$current" == -* ]]; then
    if [[ "$current" == *=* ]]; then
      flag="${current%%=*}"
      _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${options[@]}" || return
      if _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${value_flags[@]}" || _homepodctl_contains "$flag" "${boolean_flags[@]}"; then
        group="inline:$flag"
      fi
    else
      group="options:$context"
    fi
  elif (( position == 0 && ${#children[@]} > 0 )); then
    group="children:$context"
  elif [[ -n "$positional" ]] && (( position + offset >= start )) && (( repeat || position + offset == start )); then
    group="$positional"
  elif (( ! ended )) && [[ -z "$current" ]]; then
    group="options:$context"
  fi
}

_homepodctl_values() {
  candidates=() descriptions=()
  case "$1" in
    'aliases') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'backends') candidates=('airplay' 'native'); descriptions=() ;;
    'booleans') candidates=('true' 'false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'children:automation') candidates=('init' 'plan' 'run' 'validate'); descriptions=('' 'Preview command execution' 'Run alias' '') ;;
    'children:completion') candidates=('install' 'bash' 'zsh' 'fish'); descriptions=('' '' '' '') ;;
    'children:config') candidates=('get' 'set' 'validate'); descriptions=('' '' '') ;;
    'children:out') candidates=('list' 'set'); descriptions=('' '') ;;
    'children:plan') candidates=('automation' 'native-run' 'out' 'play' 'run' 'vol' 'volume'); descriptions=('Run automation routines' 'Run shortcut' 'Manage outputs' 'Play playlist' 'Run alias' 'Set volume' 'Set volume') ;;
    'children:plan automation') candidates=('run'); descriptions=('Run alias') ;;
    'children:plan out') candidates=('set'); descriptions=('') ;;
    'children:root') candidates=('aliases' 'automation' 'completion' 'config' 'config-init' 'devices' 'doctor' 'help' 'native-run' 'next' 'now' 'out' 'pause' 'plan' 'play' 'playlists' 'prev' 'run' 'schema' 'setup' 'status' 'stop' 'version' 'vol' 'volume'); descriptions=('List aliases' 'Run automation routines' 'Generate shell completion' 'Inspect/update config' 'Write starter config' 'List devices' 'Run diagnostics' 'Show help' 'Run shortcut' 'Next track' 'Alias of status' 'Manage outputs' 'Pause playback' 'Preview command execution' 'Play playlist' 'List playlists' 'Previous track' 'Run alias' 'Show JSON schemas' 'Onboard and verify environment' 'Show playback, route, and backend status' 'Stop playback' 'Show version' 'Set volume' 'Set volume') ;;
    'commands') candidates=('aliases' 'automation' 'completion' 'config' 'config-init' 'devices' 'doctor' 'help' 'native-run' 'next' 'now' 'out' 'pause' 'plan' 'play' 'playlists' 'prev' 'run' 'schema' 'setup' 'status' 'stop' 'version' 'vol' 'volume'); descriptions=('List aliases' 'Run automation routines' 'Generate shell completion' 'Inspect/update config' 'Write starter config' 'List devices' 'Run diagnostics' 'Show help' 'Run shortcut' 'Next track' 'Alias of status' 'Manage outputs' 'Pause playback' 'Preview command execution' 'Play playlist' 'List playlists' 'Previous track' 'Run alias' 'Show JSON schemas' 'Onboard and verify environment' 'Show playback, route, and backend status' 'Stop playback' 'Show version' 'Set volume' 'Set volume') ;;
    'inline:--backend') candidates=('--backend=airplay' '--backend=native'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--choose') candidates=('--choose=true' '--choose=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--dry-run') candidates=('--dry-run=true' '--dry-run=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--include-network') candidates=('--include-network=true' '--include-network=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--json') candidates=('--json=true' '--json=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--no-input') candidates=('--no-input=true' '--no-input=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--plain') candidates=('--plain=true' '--plain=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--playlist') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--preset') candidates=('--preset=morning' '--preset=focus' '--preset=winddown' '--preset=party' '--preset=reset'); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--room') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'inline:--shuffle') candidates=('--shuffle=true' '--shuffle=false'); descriptions=() ;;
    'options:aliases') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:automation') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'options:automation init') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--name' '--preset' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Routine name' 'Preset name' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:automation plan') candidates=('--file' '--help' '--json' '-f' '-h'); descriptions=('Input file' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Input file' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:automation run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--file' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '-f' '-h'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Input file' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Non-interactive mode' 'Input file' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:automation validate') candidates=('--file' '--help' '--json' '-f' '-h'); descriptions=('Input file' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Input file' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:completion') candidates=('--help' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:completion install') candidates=('--help' '--path' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Completion installation path' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:config') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'options:config get') candidates=('--help' '--json' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:config set') candidates=('--help' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:config validate') candidates=('--help' '--json' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:config-init') candidates=('--help' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:devices') candidates=('--help' '--include-network' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Include network address' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:doctor') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:help') candidates=('--help' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:native-run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--shortcut' '-h'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Shortcut name' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:next') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:now') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '--watch' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Poll interval' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:out') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'options:out list') candidates=('--help' '--include-network' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Include network address' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:out set') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '-h'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:pause') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:plan') candidates=('--json'); descriptions=('Output JSON') ;;
    'options:plan automation') candidates=('--json'); descriptions=('Output JSON') ;;
    'options:plan automation run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--file' '--json' '--no-input' '-f'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Input file' 'Output JSON' 'Non-interactive mode' 'Input file') ;;
    'options:plan native-run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--json' '--shortcut'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Shortcut name') ;;
    'options:plan out') candidates=('--json'); descriptions=('Output JSON') ;;
    'options:plan out set') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name') ;;
    'options:plan play') candidates=('--backend' '--choose' '--dry-run' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--shuffle' '--volume'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Choose among playlist matches' 'Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Non-interactive mode' 'Plain output' 'Playlist name' 'Playlist ID' 'Room name' 'Shuffle toggle' 'Volume 0-100') ;;
    'options:plan run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--json' '--plain'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output') ;;
    'options:plan vol') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name' 'Volume 0-100' 'Volume 0-100') ;;
    'options:plan volume') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name' 'Volume 0-100' 'Volume 0-100') ;;
    'options:play') candidates=('--backend' '--choose' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '--plain' '--playlist' '--playlist-id' '--room' '--shuffle' '--volume' '-h'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Choose among playlist matches' 'Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Non-interactive mode' 'Plain output' 'Playlist name' 'Playlist ID' 'Room name' 'Shuffle toggle' 'Volume 0-100' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:playlists') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--limit' '--plain' '--query' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Maximum results' 'Plain output' 'Playlist filter' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:prev') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:root') candidates=('--help' '--quiet' '--verbose' '--version' '-h' '-q' '-v'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Suppress non-essential success output' 'Verbose diagnostics' 'Show version' 'Show help' 'Suppress non-essential success output' 'Verbose diagnostics') ;;
    'options:run') candidates=('--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:schema') candidates=('--help' '--json' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:setup') candidates=('--backend' '--help' '--json' '--no-input' '--room' '-h'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Non-interactive mode' 'Room name' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:status') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '--watch' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Poll interval' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:stop') candidates=('--help' '--json' '--plain' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:version') candidates=('--help' '-h'); descriptions=('Show help' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:vol') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume' '-h'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name' 'Volume 0-100' 'Volume 0-100' 'Show help') ;;
    'options:volume') candidates=('--backend' '--dry-run' '--help' '--json' '--plain' '--room' '--value' '--volume' '-h'); descriptions=('Playback backend' 'Preview without side effects' 'Show help' 'Output JSON' 'Plain output' 'Room name' 'Volume 0-100' 'Volume 0-100' 'Show help') ;;
    'playlists') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'presets') candidates=('morning' 'focus' 'winddown' 'party' 'reset'); descriptions=() ;;
    'rooms') candidates=(); descriptions=() ;;
    'shells') candidates=('bash' 'zsh' 'fish'); descriptions=() ;;

  esac
}

_homepodctl_unquote() {
  local raw="$1" quote='' char next
  unquoted='' word_prefix=''
  # Remove shell quoting without evaluating user text or substitutions.
  while [[ -n "$raw" ]]; do
    char="${raw:0:1}"; raw="${raw:1}"
    if [[ "$quote" == "'" ]]; then
      if [[ "$char" == "'" ]]; then quote=''; else unquoted+="$char"; fi
    elif [[ "$char" == \\ ]]; then
      next="${raw:0:1}"
      if [[ -z "$quote" || "$next" == '$' || "$next" == '"' || "$next" == \\ || "$next" == $'\x60' || "$next" == $'\n' ]]; then
        [[ "$next" != $'\n' ]] && unquoted+="$next"
        raw="${raw:1}"
      else
        unquoted+="$char"
      fi
    elif [[ "$char" == "$quote" ]]; then
      quote=''
    elif [[ -z "$quote" && ( "$char" == "'" || "$char" == '"' ) ]]; then
      quote="$char"
    else
      unquoted+="$char"
      if [[ -z "$quote" && "${COMP_WORDBREAKS-}" == *"$char"* ]]; then word_prefix="$unquoted"; fi
    fi
  done
  completion_quote="$quote"
}

_homepodctl_quote() {
  local value="$1" single_quote_escape="'\\''"
  case "$completion_quote" in
    "'") quoted="${value//\'/$single_quote_escape}" ;;
    '"')
      quoted="${value//\\/\\\\}"
      quoted="${quoted//\"/\\\"}"
      quoted="${quoted//\$/\\\$}"
      quoted="${quoted//$'\x60'/\\$'\x60'}" ;;
    *) printf -v quoted '%q' "$value" ;;
  esac
}

_homepodctl_completion() {
  local group current candidate index=1 split_prefix='' word unquoted join_next=0 adjacent remaining word_prefix completion_quote quoted
  local -a candidates descriptions input decoded
  COMPREPLY=()
  remaining="${COMP_LINE#*"${COMP_WORDS[0]}"}"
  # Bash normally makes '=' a separate COMP_WORDS entry. Rejoin it for
  # scanning, then return only the part that Readline will replace.
  while (( index <= COMP_CWORD )); do
    word="${COMP_WORDS[index]}"
    adjacent=0
    if [[ -z "${COMP_LINE+x}" || "$remaining" == "$word"* ]]; then adjacent=1; fi
    remaining="${remaining#*"$word"}"
    if [[ "$word" == = && ${#input[@]} -gt 0 ]] && (( adjacent )); then
      input[${#input[@]}-1]+='='
      if (( index == COMP_CWORD )); then split_prefix="${input[${#input[@]}-1]}"; fi
      join_next=1
    elif (( join_next && adjacent )); then
      if (( index == COMP_CWORD )); then split_prefix="${input[${#input[@]}-1]}"; fi
      input[${#input[@]}-1]+="$word"
      join_next=0
    else
      input+=("$word")
      join_next=0
    fi
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
  for word in "${input[@]}"; do
    _homepodctl_unquote "$word"
    decoded+=("$unquoted")
  done
  # Readline may replace only the suffix even when COMP_WORDS keeps the
  # assignment intact (notably stock macOS Bash).
  if [[ -n "$word_prefix" ]]; then split_prefix="$word_prefix"; fi
  _homepodctl_scan "${decoded[@]}"
  _homepodctl_values "$group"
  for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$candidate" == "$current"* ]]; then
      _homepodctl_quote "${candidate#"$split_prefix"}"
      COMPREPLY+=("$quoted")
    fi
  done
}
complete -F _homepodctl_completion homepodctl
